title: More protective and fun mods
description: This mod adds practical companion items, rare iron golem taming and various interesting survival tweaks to enrich your Minecraft adventure gameplay.
body:
# More Protective & Fun Mods

A small, cozy mod focused on adding player-friendly features and fun tweaks to your Minecraft world!

## ✨ Features
- **Master-Protecting Whistle**: Summon all your nearby tamed creatures to your side instantly.
- **Emergency Rescue Kit**: Automatically activates when your health is critically low, keeping you alive.
- **Iron Golem Taming**: Win the trust of iron golems with poppies, and they’ll become your loyal bodyguards.
- **Cat Repayment Mechanic**: Feed fish to your cats, and they’ll bring you random gifts, including rare items like diamonds!
- **Wet Creeper Tweak**: Wet creepers won’t destroy blocks anymore, but they’ll still deal a small amount of damage to keep things balanced.
- **Villager Protection**: Villagers can no longer open doors, keeping them safe from zombies and other threats.

## 📢 Stay Updated
This mod is updated **once a month** with new features, bug fixes, and quality-of-life improvements!

## 💬 Feedback & Suggestions
Have an idea for a new player-protection item, mechanic, or any other feature you’d love to see added? Feel free to share your suggestions! I’ll read every one carefully, and reasonable ideas will be considered for future updates.

If you encounter any bugs or issues, please let me know so I can fix them as soon as possible.
